title: Corvi authorization details in a token response
description: The scoped `authorization_details` a Corvi token response carries under RFC 9396. There is one entry per consented identity; entries are never merged across identities, and an entry names the actions that identity alone was granted. This is a design contract, not a running endpoint.

type.description: The Corvi-defined authorization detail type; not a standard OAuth type.

identityId.description: Opaque Corvi MailIdentity identifier; never an email address or a provider account id.

unattendedSend.description: A consent cannot approve an unattended send; only a separately designated server policy may.

x-corvi.notes: Provider OAuth tokens (ADR-0008) are never Corvi authorization details and never authenticate a Corvi request.
